chapter_tool_materials.question: What standardized analytical protocols (LC-MS/MS or GC-MS parameters, sample processing standards) exist for quantifying absolute physiological concentrations of inosine and short-chain fatty acids in human serum or tumor tissue, and are there cancer-specific reference ranges or consensus statements?
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content: This study provides specific LC-MS/MS analytical parameters for quantifying adenosine and inosine in murine tumor tissues, including column type (ZORBAX RRHD Eclipse Plus C18), mobile phase gradients (water/acetonitrile with 0.1% FA), flow rate (300 µL min⁻¹), and MRM transitions (inosine 269.1/136.8, adenosine 268.1/135.9). It also describes a solid-phase microextraction (SPME) technique for measuring free metabolite concentrations in the tumor microenvironment using HLB-PAN fibers and kinetic calibration. A baseline adenosine concentration of 0.04 µM is reported for control mouse tumors. This study provides a detailed methodological framework for serum metabolite quantification using gas-chromatography/mass-spectrometry (GC/MS), which offers supporting technical parameters for the requested gap. The authors specify sample processing standards including serum separation (3,000 x g, 10 min, 4°C), storage conditions (−80°C), and extraction protocols (MeOH:H2O:CHCl3 = 2.5:1:1 with 2-isopropylmalic acid internal standard). The study outlines specific GC/MS instrument parameters such as column type (CP-SIL 8 CB), temperature programming (80°C to 330°C), and ion-source settings (200°C), along with quality control measures like calculating relative standard deviation (RSD%) and evaluating intra-day/inter-day variance. While the specific metabolites quantified (2-hydroxybutyrate, aspartic acid, kynurenine, cystamine) do not match the gap's target (inosine or short-chain fatty acids), the documented workflow serves as a reference template for establishing absolute physiological concentration protocols in human serum. The authors also demonstrate how to establish reference concentration ranges and cut-off values for cancer patients versus healthy controls using logistic regression and ROC analysis, providing a statistical model for defining cancer-specific reference ranges even though the specific analytes differ. COPD control group mean 2.36 μM (median 1.15 μM) in discovery set.', 'relevance': 'Directly addresses success criterion (3) for reference concentration ranges in cancer patients, though controls are disease-matched (COPD) rather than healthy.'}, {'content': 'Targeted LC-MS/MS parameters for succinic acid quantification: Same HILIC method as inosine, negative ionization mode, validated according to EMA guidelines with LOQ, precision (CV < 13.8%), and accuracy (%bias < 14.8%) reported.', 'relevance': 'Provides protocol for succinic acid, a TCA cycle intermediate often analyzed alongside SCFAs, though chemically distinct from microbiome-derived SCFAs (acetate/propionate/butyrate).'}] This study details a specific LC-MS/MS method for quantifying inosine and adenosine in tumor tissue, utilizing an Agilent 1290 Infinity II UHPLC coupled to a 6475 Triple Quad mass spectrometer in positive MRM mode. Key parameters include a ZORBAX RRHD Eclipse Plus C18 column (150 mm × 3 mm, 1.8 µm), a water (0.1% formic acid)/acetonitrile gradient at 300 µL/min, and specific parent/product ion pairs for inosine (269.1/136.8) and adenosine (268.1/135.9). Sample processing employed hydrophilic-lipophilic balanced solid-phase microextraction (HLB-SPME) fibers inserted directly into murine tumors, with lamivudine as an internal standard. The authors reported a baseline adenosine concentration of approximately 0.04 µM in control mouse tumor tissue. This study confirms the use of liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) for quantifying serum short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) and inosine in patients with relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma undergoing CAR T-cell therapy. The authors report that detailed analytical procedures are described in supplemental methods, though these are not included in the supplied text. The study identifies associations between serum inosine levels and treatment response, and between specific serum fatty acids (acetate, butyrate, isovalerate) and immune-related adverse events. It establishes that these metabolites are measurable in human serum within a cancer immunotherapy context. This study utilized gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (GC–MS) to quantify short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), specifically acetic acid, in human lung adenocarcinoma tissues (n = 21) and adjacent normal tissues. The authors reported sample processing standards including tissue dissection, washing with precooled PBS, and storage at −80 °C prior to analysis. The results indicated a significant accumulation of acetic acid in tumor tissues compared to normal tissues, supporting the feasibility of SCFA quantification in tumor samples for cancer research. This study provides a validated GC-MS protocol for quantifying short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) in human serum and plasma, including specific analytical parameters (DB-FFAP column, SIM mode ions, temperature program), sample processing standards (acidification with HCl, MTBE liquid-liquid extraction, storage at −80 °C), and reference concentration ranges for acetic, propionic, butyric, and valeric acid in healthy human controls (e.g., serum acetic acid 4788–8823 ng/mL). The authors also detail a surrogate matrix approach using distilled water for calibration, validated for parallelism and matrix effects in serum. This study provides a detailed Basic Protocol for quantifying 14 short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) in human serum using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS). It specifies analytical platform parameters including the use of an Agilent 7820A GC-5977B MSD system, an HP-5 ms capillary column (30 m x 250 μm x 0.25 μm), oven temperature programming (60 °C to 325 °C), and electron impact ionization at -70 eV. The authors describe sample processing standards involving alkaline extraction (0.1 M NaOH for serum), methanol precipitation, vacuum concentration, and derivatization with N-tert-butyldimethylsilyl-N-methyltrifluoroacetamide (MTBSTFA) at 60 °C. The protocol includes storage recommendations (−80 °C for long-term) and cites the Human Metabolomics Database (HMDB) for normal concentration ranges of acetic acid in human blood (26.8 to 64.2 μM) as a reference for healthy controls. This study confirms the application of liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) for quantifying serum inosine and short-chain fatty acids (acetate, butyrate, isovalerate) in patients with relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (R/R-DLBCL). The authors report associations between pretreatment serum inosine levels and progression-free survival, as well as correlations between serum fatty acid profiles and immune-related adverse events. The discussion notes that in vitro experimental concentrations of inosine (10-30 mM) exceed physiological serum levels, highlighting the distinction between experimental dosing and endogenous concentrations. chapter_tool_materials.question: 是否存在已完成的、大规模随机对照 III 期试验证实微生物组干预在 ICI 治疗患者中的疗效？
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content: 本研究（MITRIC 试验，NCT05286294）是一项单臂、IIa 期篮子试验，纳入 12 名对免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）耐药的晚期癌症患者（主要为黑色素瘤，另有头颈鳞癌、肾细胞癌、胰腺癌各 1 例）。研究评估了来自 ICI 长期响应者的粪便微生物移植（FMT）联合 ICI 治疗的安全性和有效性。主要结果显示客观缓解率（ORR）为 0%（0/12），中位无进展生存期（PFS）为 1.5 个月，中位总生存期（OS）为 10.1 个月。仅 1 例黑色素瘤患者达到方案定义的临床获益（稳定疾病>6 个月）。安全性方面，FMT 耐受性良好，50% 患者发生免疫相关不良事件（irAEs），多为 1-2 级。研究还通过质谱流式细胞术分析了外周血免疫细胞，发现基线高分化 T 细胞特征与较好预后相关，而髓系优势环境与不良预后相关，且 FMT 未显著改变外周血免疫景观。 This study reports results from a Phase II trial (FMT-LUMINate, NCT04951583) involving 20 previously untreated patients with advanced melanoma receiving fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) combined with dual immune checkpoint inhibitors (ipilimumab and nivolumab). The design was single-arm with safety as the primary endpoint. The authors observed an objective response rate (ORR) of 70% (2 complete responses, 12 partial responses), but also noted high rates of immune-related adverse events (65% grade >3, including 20% diarrhea/colitis and 2 cases of myocarditis). The conclusion states that these results support the study of FMT and immunotherapy in the randomized setting, indicating that definitive randomized evidence is not yet established by this work.
limits: 需要检索是否有已完成的、针对微生物组干预（如 FMT 或特定菌群制剂）联合免疫检查点抑制剂的大型 III 期随机对照试验及其主要结局数据。

chapter_tool_materials.question: 是否存在已完成的、大规模随机对照 III 期试验证实微生物组干预在 ICI 治疗患者中的疗效？
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content: This study is a narrative review of 95 clinical studies (2015–2025) evaluating the gut microbiome in cancer immunotherapy. The authors report that current evidence primarily consists of observational cohorts and early-phase interventional studies (e.g., Phase I/II trials of fecal microbiota transplantation in melanoma achieving 20–40% objective response rates). The GRADE assessment explicitly states that high-certainty evidence was not reached in any domain due to methodological heterogeneity, open-label designs, and reliance on observational cohorts. The authors emphasize the need for large-scale, multi-center randomized controlled trials to validate the microbiome's role but do not list specific ongoing key Phase 3 trials (such as CanBiome2) or provide estimated completion times. 该研究通过检索 Trialtrove 数据库（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日），分析了 29 项评估微生物组调节剂（MMs）治疗结直肠癌（CRC）的临床试验。结果显示，试验管线主要由早期阶段主导：II 期试验 9 项，I 期 7 项，I/II 期 7 项，未列出已完成的 III 期试验。文中具体引用了 RENMIN-215 试验（II 期）的数据，显示 FMT 联合免疫治疗在难治性 MSS mCRC 患者中取得 ORR 20%、mPFS 9.6 个月的结果。作者明确指出“虽然 MMs 在 CRC 中的临床管线仍 predominantly early-phase（主要为早期阶段）”，这直接回应了关于是否存在已完成 III 期试验的疑问（即目前尚无）。 This study conducted a proof-of-principle randomized trial (NCT04645680) with 45 melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade, comparing a high-fiber diet intervention (50g/d) against a control diet (20g/d). The authors reported exploratory clinical outcomes including event-free survival (EFS), objective response rate (ORR), and immune-related adverse events (IRAEs). Results indicated a significant EFS benefit in the combined neoadjuvant/unresectable cohort (p=0.03) and a trend in ORR (p=0.06), with lower IRAE rates in the intervention arm. The authors explicitly concluded that these findings warrant further study in Phase III trials powered for disease outcomes. 本研究（CONTACT-03）是一项已完成的 III 期随机对照试验，评估了在既往免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗进展后的转移性肾细胞癌患者中，在酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（cabozantinib）基础上加用抗 PD-L1 药物（atezolizumab） versus 单药治疗的疗效。研究结果显示，联合组并未改善无进展生存期（PFS）或总生存期（OS），且毒性增加。虽然该研究未涉及微生物组干预，但其作为 ICI 再挑战策略失败的阴性证据，支持了综述中关于‘现有临床策略在 ICI 耐药人群中效果有限’的背景论述，从而间接突显了探索非传统机制（如微生物组干预）的必要性。 This study analyzed access to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in patients randomized to the control arm across 8 international phase 3 trials for renal cell carcinoma (RCC) and urothelial carcinoma (UC). It found that approximately 57% of control arm patients in RCC trials and 59% in UC trials received subsequent therapy, with 67% and 75% of those subsequent therapies being ICIs, respectively. The authors noted significant variability between trials, with some showing low access rates (e.g., 40.5% in CheckMate 9ER, 33.5% in KEYNOTE-564). The supplied text explicitly addresses the status of Phase III trials in the section 'Large-scale clinical evidence, meta-analytic synthesis, and long-term safety follow-up.' It states: 'as of late 2025, no completed Phase III randomized trials have yet confirmed a reproducible survival benefit of microbiome-based interventions in oncology.' The authors note that current evidence relies on Phase I/II trials (e.g., FMT studies NCT03353402, NCT03341143) and meta-analyses. The text lists several ongoing early-phase trials for engineered microbes (e.g., SYNB1891, MRx0518, SER-401) but does not provide completion dates or specific details for a Phase III trial named 'CanBiome2'. It does, however, mention a dietary intervention trial (NCT04645680) and a multi-strain probiotic trial (NCT03829111) as ongoing or emerging, without specifying them as Phase III. This study surveyed 29 clinical trials of microbiome modulators in colorectal cancer (CRC) as of June 30, 2025, finding that the pipeline is predominantly early-phase (Phase I, I/II, and II), with no mention of completed Phase 3 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) publishing primary endpoints like overall survival (OS) or progression-free survival (PFS). It reports efficacy data from Phase II trials (e.g., RENMIN-215 trial showing 20% ORR and 9.6 months mPFS with FMT plus ICIs in MSS CRC) and meta-analyses of early-phase trials, explicitly stating that 'the clinical pipeline for MMs in CRC remains predominantly early-phase'. This confirms the absence of completed large-scale Phase 3 evidence in the surveyed literature. This study describes an investigator-initiated, randomized, phase II trial (NCT06030037) evaluating P+L versus P+L plus responder-derived fecal microbiota transplantation (R-FMT) in PD-1 resistant/refractory melanoma. The text specifies the intervention protocol: R-FMT is derived from donors with durable response (mPFS ≥24 months) following prior PD-1 ICI, screened for infectious agents, and administered via endoscopy on D1 and D42 followed by oral capsules. The primary endpoint is objective response rate (ORR) by Blinded Independent Central Review, with secondary endpoints including progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS). Translational endpoints include immune activation, metagenomic engraftment, and transcriptomic analyses. Enrollment has commenced, but no efficacy results are reported. This study is a narrative review of 95 clinical studies (2015–2025) evaluating the gut microbiome in cancer immunotherapy. The authors report that current evidence primarily consists of observational cohorts and early-phase interventional studies (e.g., Phase I/II trials of fecal microbiota transplantation in melanoma achieving 20–40% objective response rates). The GRADE assessment explicitly states that high-certainty evidence was not reached in any domain due to methodological heterogeneity, open-label designs, and reliance on observational cohorts. The authors emphasize the need for large-scale, multi-center randomized controlled trials to validate the microbiome's role but do not list specific ongoing key Phase 3 trials (such as CanBiome2) or provide estimated completion times. 该研究通过检索 Trialtrove 数据库（截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日），分析了 29 项评估微生物组调节剂（MMs）治疗结直肠癌（CRC）的临床试验。结果显示，试验管线主要由早期阶段主导：II 期试验 9 项，I 期 7 项，I/II 期 7 项，未列出已完成的 III 期试验。文中具体引用了 RENMIN-215 试验（II 期）的数据，显示 FMT 联合免疫治疗在难治性 MSS mCRC 患者中取得 ORR 20%、mPFS 9.6 个月的结果。作者明确指出“虽然 MMs 在 CRC 中的临床管线仍 predominantly early-phase（主要为早期阶段）”，这直接回应了关于是否存在已完成 III 期试验的疑问（即目前尚无）。
limits: 需要检索并确认是否存在已完成的 Phase III 随机对照试验（RCT）及其主要终点（OS/PFS）数据。
chapter_tool_materials.still_missing: 该材料未能确认具体的、正在进行中的关键 III 期试验（如成功标准中提到的 CanBiome2）的名称、试验设计细节或预计完成时间。虽然材料表明目前以早期试验为主，但未明确排除是否有未收录的 III 期试验正在运行，也未提供替代的 III 期试验时间表信息。

chapter_tool_materials.question: 是否有共识指南或标准化方法用于人体肿瘤微环境或血清中关键代谢物（如肌苷、SCFAs）的绝对浓度测量？
chapter_tool_materials.usable_content: 该综述在 6.3 节专门讨论了循环微生物 DNA 和微生物组衍生代谢物（如 SCFAs、肌苷）作为外周血生物标志物的现状。明确指出目前这些发现尚未确立为经过验证的预测性生物标志物，且‘直到标准化的分析前程序、污染控制、可重复的阈值、纵向采样框架和前瞻性治疗交互测试建立之前，这些生物标志物应仍被视为探索性的’。文中还列举了具体干扰因素，包括饮食、抗生素暴露、地理位置、合并症和宿主代谢对循环代谢物浓度的影响，以及低生物量污染和批次效应问题。表 2 将此类标志物列为‘探索性反应分层和治疗监测’，主要障碍为‘低生物量污染；饮食、抗生素、地理和代谢混杂’。 This review discusses analytical platforms for metabolite quantification including LC-MS, GC-MS, and NMR spectroscopy for detecting microbial metabolites (SCFAs, bile acids, polyamines, indole derivatives) in stool, plasma, serum, and urine. Section 6.2 notes that targeted metabolomics platforms are increasingly employed for absolute quantification of predefined microbial metabolites. Section 10.7 explicitly states that 'a significant technical challenge in microbiome-metabolite research is the absence of standardized protocols for metabolomic analysis and multi-omics integration' and that 'variations in sample collection, storage conditions, extraction methods, instrument platforms, and data-processing pipelines contribute to considerable variability across studies.' The authors emphasize that 'establishing standardized guidelines for metabolomic workflows, reporting formats, and data normalization methods is essential for enhancing reproducibility and reliability.' Table 2 summarizes advantages and limitations of various analytical techniques. The review mentions SCFAs (butyrate, acetate, propionate) as frequently studied metabolites detectable in accessible biological matrices but does not provide specific consensus protocols, reference ranges, or absolute concentration standards for inosine or SCFAs in tumor microenvironment or serum. ['该综述明确指出目前缺乏针对肌苷在结直肠癌（CRC）发生过程中不同肠道 compartment 空间分布的临床研究，现有数据多源于“批量代谢组学分析”（bulk metabolomic analysis），未提供标准化的绝对浓度测量协议。', '文中提到目前没有人研究纵向追踪从结肠炎到异型增生再到确诊 CRC 过程中的肌苷水平或嘌呤代谢通量，表明缺乏标准化的纵向监测方案。', '引用了一项 II 期临床试验（n=172），其中肌苷作为免疫治疗辅助（0.2 g 口服，每日三次），但未单独报告 CRC 亚组结果，且未提及血清或肿瘤微环境中内源性肌苷的基线测量标准或参考范围。', '指出肌苷在人体 CRC 患者中的特征描述相比其他代谢物（如胆汁酸、SCFAs）仍不足，暗示该领域尚未形成统一的测量或报告共识。'] This study details a novel, fast (~8 min) vendor-neutral multi-parametric quantitative MRI (mp-qMRI) protocol and a specific method for the absolute quantification of cerebral metabolites (e.g., tNAA, tCho, tCr) in brain tumors. The authors demonstrate that standard quantification methods relying on literature values for water relaxation times lead to significant errors (underestimation of ~15% in tumor regions and ~35% in some comparisons) compared to methods using individual-specific qMRI-derived corrections. The study proposes a 'gold standard' approach involving qMRI-based water content (H2O), T1, and T2 mapping to correct spectroscopic data, and further introduces a streamlined method synthesizing the water reference from qMRI maps calibrated by a single-voxel STEAM sequence. The material provides specific acquisition parameters (mGRE, EPI, STEAM), processing algorithms, and validation data showing high inter-scanner reproducibility for these quantitative metrics in a clinical setting. ["该综述明确指出‘绝对定量（absolute quantification）’是该领域未来进展的必要条件之一（'Future progress will require... absolute quantification'），表明目前尚缺乏标准化的绝对浓度测量共识。", '文中提及了与免疫治疗相关的关键代谢物，如肌苷（inosine，引用 Mager et al., 2020）、短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）、犬尿烯酸（kynurenic acid）和丁酸（butyrate），确认了这些是肿瘤微环境或血清中值得测量的目标分子。', '针对低生物量样本（如脑组织、肿瘤微环境），提出了严格的方法学标准，包括污染控制（试剂空白、阴性对照）、空间验证（FISH、质谱成像等）和报告规范（STORMS 指南），这些原则可延伸至代谢物测量的标准化设计中。', '区分了‘细菌信号/元素’（如 DNA、LPS、代谢物）与‘活性定植微生物’的证据等级，强调代谢物检测需结合空间定位和宿主反应特征，避免将循环代谢物误认为局部定植产物。', '指出肠道微生物群衍生的代谢物（如色氨酸 - 犬尿氨酸轴、SCFAs）可通过血脑屏障或血肿瘤屏障影响脑转移微环境，提示血清测量与组织测量需结合屏障通透性进行解释。'] 该研究明确指出当前领域面临的主要挑战是缺乏方法学标准化（lack of methodological standardization），这导致了观察结果的不一致并阻碍了因果推断。 authors 呼吁未来需要采用协调方案（harmonized protocols）的大规模纵向多组学临床试验。此外，研究提出了肠道来源代谢物可增强全身免疫治疗，而局部微生物组可能干扰局部治疗的双轨效应模型，为代谢物测量位点（血清 vs 肿瘤微环境）的选择提供了理论背景。 This review explicitly identifies the absence of standardized protocols for metabolomic analysis as a significant technical challenge in microbiome-metabolite research (Section 10.7). The authors note that variability in sample collection, storage conditions, metabolite extraction procedures, analytical platforms, and data normalization strategies contributes to inter-study inconsistency and impairs reproducibility. Section 6.2 describes analytical platforms used for metabolite profiling including LC-MS, GC-MS, and NMR spectroscopy for detecting SCFAs and other microbial metabolites in stool, plasma, serum, and urine. The paper states that 'the establishment of standardized sampling protocols, time-controlled study designs, and robust normalization strategies is essential to improve the clinical applicability of microbiome-derived metabolite biomarkers.' Table 2 summarizes advantages and limitations of various metabolomic techniques. Section 8.3 discusses methodological and translational barriers in biomarker standardization, noting that successful integration requires rigorous assessment of analytical robustness, scalability, and harmonized reporting standards.
